title: Vision And Text Transformer For Predicting Answerability On Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2609.16565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Answerability on Visual Question Answering is a novel and attractive task to predict answerable scores between images and questions in multi-modal data. Existing works often utilize a binary mapping from visual question answering systems into Answerability. It does not reflect the essence of this problem. Together with our consideration of Answerability in a regression task, we propose VT-Transformer, which exploits visual and textual features through Transformer architecture. Experimental results on VizWiz 2020 dataset show the effectiveness and robustness of VT-Transformer for Answerability on Visual Question Answering when comparing with competitive baselines.

translated_title: 用于预测视觉问答可回答性的视觉与文本Transformer
translated_abstract: 视觉问答中的可回答性预测是一项新颖且有吸引力的任务，用于预测多模态数据中图像与问题之间的可回答分数。现有工作通常采用从视觉问答系统到可回答性的二元映射，这并不能反映该问题的本质。结合我们将可回答性视为回归任务的考量，我们提出了VT-Transformer，它通过Transformer架构充分利用视觉和文本特征。在VizWiz 2020数据集上的实验结果表明，与竞争性基线方法相比，VT-Transformer在视觉问答可回答性预测任务上表现出了有效性和鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出VT-Transformer模型，将视觉问答中的可回答性预测作为回归任务处理，通过Transformer架构融合视觉与文本特征，在VizWiz 2020数据集上验证了其相比基线方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VT-Transformer, which treats answerability prediction in Visual Question Answering as a regression task and leverages visual and textual features through a Transformer architecture, demonstrating effectiveness and robustness over competitive baselines on the VizWiz 2020 dataset.
